cohort: The participants were certified Israeli midwives working in a hospital delivery room.
finding: Self-compassion was significantly correlated with psychosocial health and well-being, and low self-compassion significantly interacted with exposure to traumatic birth in the last year to negatively affect psychosocial well-being.
cross-section timing: Data was collected at a single point in time, assessing current psychosocial well-being and self-compassion in relation to traumatic birth experiences in the last year.
